status: The owner asked to "find another third style outside of Icon that fits well" (28 October 2026), after Icon failed two style rounds. Measurement only; nothing is registered or deployed.
purpose: Bake-off of three candidate third styles (Gouache, Engraving, Fresco) on 12 launch-matrix cases chosen for the known failure classes: God scenes, writing-prone scenes, crowds and moments. The winner gets the full 33-case matrix before any release.
design: Each case is prepared once, cold, in one shared memory store seeded from the launch matrix's read-only production snapshot, then rendered in each candidate style through the engine's styleOverride with no style reference. Every first image is checked; a faulty one gets one retry, exactly as the request path does. Cases run three at a time.

cases.expected: Light breaking over formless dark waters; no human figure for God; no text.
Moses' hand stretched out, a strong east wind, the sea dividing with a dry seabed; night.
Six-winged seraphim above a throne, faces and feet covered; temple smoke.
A throne of flames with burning wheels, white garments, hair like wool; visionary, not a portrait.
A sea of glass before the throne and four living creatures full of eyes.
A scroll or family line from Abraham through David to Jesus, shown without legible writing.
Three generations of a family line in Bethlehem; no name labels.
Soldiers casting lots for garments beneath the cross; the crucifixion treated seriously, no gratuitous gore.
A young shepherd's sling stone striking a giant warrior's forehead; valley battlefield.
Jesus calling at a tomb's mouth as a wrapped figure emerges; mourners.
A father running to embrace a ragged returning son on the road.
Green pastures and still waters with sheep and a shepherd; calm.

scoring.method: As in the launch matrix: shuffled opaque names, two independent blind model scorers per batch of about 12 images, operator adjudication committed before unblinding. Not human acceptance.
scoring.decision: Pick the candidate with the most acceptable shown images, provided it reaches at least 65% (8 of 12) and draws no no-form figure; ties go to fewer lettering, frame and margin faults. The winner then runs the full 33 cases against the per-style bar, and the owner signs off on its contact sheet.

knownLimitation: Twelve cases and one image per case and style: a screen, not a release measurement. Candidates run without a style reference.
